title: MoI-Bench: A Benchmark for Image Generation and Editing on Mobile Devices
abstract: arXiv:2610.37599v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Developing on-device image models requires considering practical user needs, task types and device resource constraints. However, existing benchmarks provide limited guidance on identifying capability gaps between on-device models and server-side models. We introduce MoI-Bench, a benchmark grounded in mobile user needs, comprising 64 subtasks and 1150 samples. It defines 16 operations, such as removal and replacement, and eight visual target categories covering content such as portraits and text. These form two orthogonal axes whose applicable combinations define specific tasks, such as removing facial makeup. To better guide model improvement, we further propose MoI-Eval, which introduces task-specific criteria covering instruction following, visual quality and detail preservation. We further construct sample-level evaluation questions and aggregate their scores into overall quality and capability profiles along the operation, target

translated_title: MoI-Bench：面向移动设备的图像生成与编辑基准测试
translated_abstract: 开发端侧图像模型需要考虑实际用户需求、任务类型以及设备资源限制。然而，现有的基准测试在识别端侧模型与服务器端模型之间的能力差距方面提供的指导十分有限。我们提出了MoI-Bench，这是一个基于移动用户需求构建的基准测试，包含64个子任务和1150个样本。该基准定义了16种操作（如移除和替换），以及八个视觉目标类别（涵盖人像和文本等内容）。这两者构成两个正交维度，其适用的组合定义了具体任务，例如卸除面部妆容。为了更好地指导模型改进，我们进一步提出了MoI-Eval，它引入了涵盖指令遵循、视觉质量和细节保留等维度的任务特定评价标准。我们还构建了样本级别的评估问题，并将其分数汇总为沿操作和目标维度展开的整体质量与能力画像。
tldr: 提出了基于移动用户需求的图像生成与编辑基准测试MoI-Bench（包含64个子任务、1150个样本、16种操作和8个视觉目标类别），并配套提出任务特定的评估方法MoI-Eval，以量化端侧模型与服务器端模型的能力差距并指导模型改进。
en_tdlr: We introduce MoI-Bench, a mobile user-needs-grounded benchmark with 64 subtasks, 1150 samples, 16 operations and 8 visual target categories, together with MoI-Eval, a task-specific evaluation framework to identify capability gaps between on-device and server-side image models and guide model improvement.
